gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-miriam-libre: Tube-light letters, loud and chunky: Tilt Neon packs oversized lowercase and stubby ascenders. Miriam Libre follows with wire-thin strokes and a friendly s, giving the loud heading something quieter to lean on.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-montserrat-underline: Commanding from the first glance, Tilt Neon draws tube-like strokes that never thin out, with short ascenders and a chunky lowercase. Montserrat Underline does the quiet work, its round bowls holding steady.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans: Tilt Neon holds one tube-like line weight from end to end. Noto Sans, with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height and an open c, would carry a full page without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Tilt Neon hits hard, its bowls weighted exactly like its stems and its ascenders kept short. Noto Sans Adlam steps in with curve endings held well apart, leaving the loud heading room to breathe.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Bold tube-like joins that never thin out give Tilt Neon its punch, while Noto Sans Armenian brings tall, full lowercase. One shouts; the other keeps its round letters wide and inviting.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Tilt Neon excels at impact, its lines thick everywhere with no hairlines to vanish in glare. Noto Sans Balinese does the opposite job, giving every curved glyph breathing space and short ascenders.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-bamum: A constant-width, tube-like stroke defines Tilt Neon, while Noto Sans Bamum keeps big open counters in every small letter. Giving the heading extra size lets that tube line glow.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Tilt Neon draws plain, unshaded lines with a body-heavy lowercase under short ascenders. Noto Sans Bengali keeps open-mouthed letters, but shrink the heading and its tubes lose their glow.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-coptic: A stroke that never changes width gives Tilt Neon its glowing-tube look. Noto Sans Coptic then fills the line with a dominant middle zone and open s and c, a quiet partner for that heading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Tilt Neon draws a pen-like line that never changes width, with a generous lowercase. Noto Sans Devanagari sits beside it with an open-bellied g and a compact skyline where capitals melt into lowercase.
